subject.title: fix: workflow sanity audit passes on main

question: Do both the primary and fallback GitHub App installations intentionally grant `contents: read` for these repository automations?
rationale: The code requests the same explicit scope from two private App installations, but repository source and public workflow runs cannot establish the fallback installation's private permission grant.

options.title: Confirm both App scopes
options.body: Verify that both App installations grant repository contents read access, then allow the PR to proceed with the explicit least-privilege token scopes.

options.title: Pause for App configuration repair
options.body: If either App cannot grant the scope, repair the App installation configuration before merging so the fallback automation path remains functional.

recommendation.title: Confirm both App scopes
recommendation.body: Verify that both App installations grant repository contents read access, then allow the PR to proceed with the explicit least-privilege token scopes.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for repository automation policy and private App configuration ownership.
